remaining_limits: The search covers the pinned CARD-cross-referenced UniProt snapshot, not all of UniProt.
A paper can concern many different genes, taxa or alleles; overlap never establishes identity.
A literal gene-name match may identify a family shared by several organisms, not one allele.
Absent overlap does not invalidate an explicit reference or imply absence of evidence.
TaxIDs are reference contexts, including mixed or uncultured names, not experimental isolates.
DOI case is normalized for comparison; reference numbers retain citation-to-entry provenance.
Malformed bibliography IDs are hashed and excluded from matching, not repaired by assumption.
No sequences, exact variants, protocols, coordinates or numerical AST are exported.
No source adoption, NCBI requests or GitHub mutation; whole-corpus primary review remains OPEN.
The exact experimental protein form and tested compound preparation remain unresolved.
Citation-specific strain annotations are not an entry-wide strain assignment.
No source term merge, biological record edit, exact variants, sequences, constructs, protocols or numerical AST.
No NCBI endpoint requests, outreach, source adoption or GitHub mutation; #1040 remains deferred.
review_findings_addressed: The full pinned 4182-entry snapshot is searched, not just the 979 previously linked proteins.
Existing explicit reference projections are reproduced without treating shared citations as new assignments.
Eighteen malformed DOI annotations are quarantined and hashed rather than guessed or silently dropped.
Different-gene and multi-organism family overlaps remain distinct, even for unique shared-paper hits.
Active TaxIDs retain rank and mixed/uncultured names; they do not establish experimental subject identity.
TlrB source and host species, citation-specific strains, negative findings and causal limits are retained.
Portable tests do not require ignored response caches; local full-source reproduction is explicit.
